description: Admin review subjects, the admin.v1 challenge member and row, and canGrant. reviewKinds lists the admin kinds that have a subject; every other kind is refused at review and challenge. subjectPairs counts the valid security.device-capabilities subjects over every pair of capability sets, and grantPairs the pairs of a nonempty held set and such a subject that canGrant accepts; grants holds canGrant(held, subject) cases.
